facts.fact: The Mauritian Sign Language electronic dictionary (MSL E-Dictionary) was launched at the Beau-Bassin school for the deaf at a ceremony with social integration minister Ashok Subron, who praised his ministry's collaboration with the Society for the Welfare of the Deaf.

systems.owner: Ministry of Social Integration with Society for the Welfare of the Deaf

note: Planned amendments to the 2024 disability act are not stated to concern information or digital access.
